full_details: Before church you read the King's last days and wrote one question beside the chronicle, on a thing done and the account that survives it. At St Helen's the parish was in black. The gospel was long. You wrote nothing there. There was no bread and no cup. In the afternoon the house was still. You did no work on the king. You opened the commonplace book at Verona, looked, and added two notes and no line. Then you shut it. At the window you named a king, two houses, and Easter, and you sat still. Evening prayer was black again, and short, and you brought nothing back to the page.
one_sentence: You asked one question of the chronicle, stood through the long gospel in black, and in the afternoon wrote two notes at Verona.
title: Stood through the long gospel and wrote two notes at Verona
